description: Hand in a student-annotation assignment (where you mark up a document inside Canvas). Do the annotating in Canvas first; this submits what is there. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true. Apps that can ask the user directly will show a confirmation instead.]

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

comment.description: Comment text, visible to your instructor.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

name: submit_annotation_assignment
title: Submit Annotation Assignment
